bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The biggest story is the uncertainty surrounding the Bears' starting quarterback for Week 4, as head coach Ben Johnson has not been ready to name a starting quarterback for Sunday's home game against the Jets , even after Case Keenum, the 38-year-old third-stringer, was the only quarterback on the Bears' 53-man roster to practice Wednesday . Adding to the storylines, the Bears also opened cornerback Kyler Gordon's 21-day practice window, giving them three weeks to activate him off the physically unable to perform list , as the team looks to build depth ahead of their matchup against the Jets.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: Dan Campbell revealed in his Friday press conference that the Lions had been "very much in on" trading for cornerback Joey Porter Jr. before the Steelers ultimately dealt him to the Cowboys, while also providing an encouraging update on Brian Branch's status for the secondary.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers' latest injury report ahead of Sunday's game against the Buccaneers shows DT Javon Hargrave downgraded to OUT, while EDGE Lukas Van Ness was removed from the injury report . The news comes as the 1-2 Packers look to bounce back against winless Tampa Bay, with the team having a re-tooled offensive line heading into an ideal matchup against the 0-3 Buccaneers .

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings, now sitting at a 3-0 start to the 2026 season, bolstered their running back depth by signing Devin Neal and Audric Estime to the practice squad as Jordan Mason continues to recover from thumb surgery. The team heads into their Week 4 matchup against the winless Miami Dolphins with uncertainty around Justin Jefferson's status due to injury, though Minnesota's stout defense gives them confidence even as their offense has struggled to find consistency.
